trends.name: Social-first vertical creative
trends.signal: Vertical 9:16 is explicitly recommended for Shorts and Reels; mobile-first creative is central to current short-form advertising.
trends.use: Default format for short-form ad generation.
trends.treatment: Design for full-screen vertical composition from frame 1.
trends.hook: Visual or spoken hook immediately; avoid slow logo intro.
trends.on_screen: Keep key message inside mobile safe areas.
trends.platform: YouTube Shorts / Instagram Reels / Facebook Reels
trends.source: Google Ads Shorts guidance; Meta Reels guidance

trends.name: 2–3 second scroll-stop hook
trends.signal: Current creator/ad guidance emphasizes an immediate opening before the viewer scrolls.
trends.use: Make hook selection a first-class creative field.
trends.treatment: Problem, POV, surprise, demo, testimonial or comment-reply opener.
trends.hook: Large, concise hook text can reinforce the first spoken/visual beat.
trends.source: Current 2026 UGC/ad guidance; hook-focused industry research

trends.name: Creator-native / UGC-style advertising
trends.signal: Creator-led and authentic content are increasingly integrated into paid advertising; Meta and Google both recommend authentic creator assets.
trends.use: Offer UGC/native route alongside polished product-film route.
trends.treatment: Creator speaks to camera, hands-only demo, casual testimonial or native POV.
trends.hook: Use conversational captions rather than corporate copy.
trends.source: Meta India 2026 retail findings; Google Shorts best practices

trends.name: Micro/nano creator trust layer
trends.signal: Meta reports micro- and nano-creators reshaping trust and purchase decisions in India.
trends.use: Allow creator persona selection by audience/context.
trends.treatment: Local creator demonstrating product in a real setting.
trends.hook: Use creator-style lower thirds and short proof points.
trends.source: Meta India retail whitepaper, Feb 2026

trends.name: Faceless / hands-only product demo
trends.signal: 2026 UGC reporting identifies faceless formats as an emerging pattern.
trends.use: Useful for products where identity is unnecessary and product action is the proof.
trends.treatment: Hands + product + environment; minimize presenter overhead.
trends.hook: Use direct action labels such as “Write → Erase → Rewrite”.
trends.source: 2026 UGC trend reporting

trends.name: Product action early
trends.signal: Short-form guidance increasingly favors showing the product and its value quickly.
trends.use: Prioritize product visibility in the first scene when objective is demonstration or conversion.
trends.treatment: Start with the action, not a generic establishing shot.
trends.hook: Overlay one benefit or action phrase over the product action.
trends.source: Current paid-UGC guidance and Shorts/Reels practices

trends.name: On-screen text as a core message layer
trends.signal: Google recommends text overlays for Shorts; Meta highlights key messages in safe zones.
trends.use: Generate synchronized on-screen text from the intent and scene message.
trends.treatment: Use one short message per beat; animate only when useful.
trends.hook: Hook → benefit → proof → CTA; respect safe zones.
trends.source: Google Ads Shorts best practices; Meta Reels guidance

trends.name: Sound-on + VO + music hybrid
trends.signal: Google recommends sound and notes music/voiceover can improve Shorts performance; current creative is increasingly sound-designed.
trends.use: Generate an audio plan instead of treating sound as an afterthought.
trends.treatment: Use natural product SFX under VO; music supports rather than masks the message.
trends.hook: Keep captions available even when sound is used.
trends.source: Google Ads Shorts best practices

trends.name: Native-feed visual language
trends.signal: Google explicitly recommends ads that blend with surrounding organic content.
trends.use: Add a “native social” production route.
trends.treatment: Handheld/mobile framing, natural environments, creator pacing where appropriate.
trends.hook: Avoid oversized corporate title cards unless the objective requires them.
trends.source: Google Ads Shorts creative considerations

trends.name: Shoppable short-form / content-to-commerce
trends.signal: Meta reports Reels increasingly functioning as a discovery and commerce surface in India.
trends.use: Support product-first creative with commerce-ready CTA/end-card fields.
trends.treatment: Demo → benefit → proof → product → action.
trends.hook: CTA can point to product, shop, message or catalog destination.
trends.source: Meta India Reels and retail findings, 2026

trends.name: WhatsApp conversational commerce
trends.signal: Meta reports WhatsApp becoming a major discovery and conversion channel in India.
trends.use: Add WhatsApp/message CTA as an optional delivery route when relevant.
trends.treatment: Ad ends with a simple invitation to ask, order or enquire.
trends.hook: Use concise CTA such as “Ask on WhatsApp” only when configured.
trends.source: Meta India retail whitepaper, Feb 2026

trends.name: Localization beyond translation
trends.signal: Meta describes Indian discovery as spanning diverse communities and regional creators; localization is increasingly tied to culture and behavior.
trends.use: Make language, setting, creator and cultural cues configurable.
trends.treatment: Regional creator, setting, idiom and product-use context.
trends.hook: Use local-language overlays when the audience warrants it.
trends.source: Meta India Reels study and retail findings

trends.name: AI-generated UGC / avatar-assisted creative
trends.signal: Meta is exploring UGC-style videos with avatars and voiceovers and expanding generative AI creative capabilities.
trends.use: Add an AI-UGC route, clearly separated from real creator assets.
trends.treatment: Avatar/AI presenter only when it improves the brief; otherwise use product-action creative.
trends.hook: Label AI-generated/edited assets where required.
trends.source: Meta 2026 advertising updates; Google AI-label guidance

trends.name: AI disclosure / transparency
trends.signal: Google notes AI-generated or AI-edited ads may require labels under applicable rules, including India.
trends.use: Make AI disclosure metadata a production/QA field.
trends.treatment: Preserve a machine-readable AI-origin flag through the package.
trends.hook: Add required disclosure/label according to platform and jurisdiction.
trends.source: Google Ads Shorts AI-label guidance

trends.name: Catalog product video / videofication
trends.signal: Meta describes catalog product video as an increasingly important always-on retail creative approach.
trends.use: Support repeatable product-video generation from catalog/product data.
trends.treatment: Product cutout → use case → benefit → proof → CTA.
trends.hook: Keep product identity and offer information consistent across variants.
trends.source: Meta India 'Videofication of Indian Shopping', May 2026

trends.name: Creative variation at scale
trends.signal: Platform guidance increasingly supports testing multiple creatives and formats rather than relying on one bespoke asset.
trends.use: Generate controlled variants from one intent package.
trends.treatment: Change one variable at a time: hook, creator, opening visual, benefit or CTA.
trends.hook: Keep brand/product claims locked while variants change.
trends.source: Google Shorts testing guidance; Meta Reels A/B testing guidance

trends.name: Hook × angle × creator matrix
trends.signal: Current UGC practice favors batches of variations rather than a single creative.
trends.use: Add a variation matrix to AdManthan delivery.
trends.treatment: Generate combinations of hook, creative angle and presenter/creator mode.
trends.hook: Maintain a consistent core claim across the matrix.
trends.source: 2026 UGC advertising practice reports

trends.name: Comment-reply / conversational ad
trends.signal: Reply-style openings are increasingly used in creator advertising because they resemble native social interaction.
trends.use: Add comment/reply as a selectable creative route.
trends.treatment: Open with a viewer question or objection, then answer with proof.
trends.hook: Show a short comment/question card only when authentic to the concept.
trends.source: 2026 UGC hook guidance

trends.name: Before → after / proof transformation
trends.signal: Demonstration and proof remain strong native patterns for product-led short-form ads.
trends.use: Add proof/transformation as a reusable narrative arc.
trends.treatment: Show problem state, action, result, then product/CTA.
trends.hook: Use measurable or observable proof; avoid unsupported superiority claims.
trends.source: Current short-form paid-UGC guidance

trends.name: ASMR / tactile product sound
trends.signal: Product-use sounds are increasingly used to make short-form creative feel physical and immersive.
trends.use: Allow tactile SFX as a deliberate effect shortcut.
trends.treatment: Macro action with pen, paper, packaging, click, spray, texture or movement.
trends.hook: On-screen text should stay minimal while the sensory action carries attention.
trends.source: Observed creative pattern; production inference

trends.name: Trend-adjacent creative placement
trends.signal: Meta is expanding trending-content categories for Reels ad inventory, increasing the role of culturally relevant content environments.
trends.use: Add a cultural/trend relevance field without forcing a trend into every ad.
trends.treatment: Use trend context only when it supports the product objective.
trends.hook: Keep trend reference subordinate to brand/product clarity.
trends.source: Meta 2026 retail/Reels updates

trends.name: Dynamic aspect-ratio / placement adaptation
trends.signal: Meta and Google increasingly provide automated creative adaptation and multi-format delivery.
trends.use: Store one master creative with placement-specific adaptations.
trends.treatment: Generate 9:16 first, then controlled derivatives for other placements.
trends.hook: Preserve text safe zones and product visibility in every derivative.
trends.source: Meta Reels Advantage+ creative; Google multi-format guidance

trends.name: Outcome-led creative testing
trends.signal: IAB reports growing buyer emphasis on business outcomes as digital video investment increases.
trends.use: Tie creative variants to objective and measurement fields.
trends.treatment: Create objective-specific variants: awareness, consideration, lead, conversion.
trends.hook: CTA and end-card language should follow the declared objective.
trends.source: IAB 2026 Digital Video Ad Spend & Strategy report

trends.name: 10–30 second action-oriented ad
trends.signal: Google recommends 10–30 second vertical videos for action-oriented Shorts campaigns.
trends.use: Make 10–30 seconds a supported default duration band, not a hard universal rule.
trends.treatment: Compress to one clear action/problem/benefit/CTA arc.
trends.hook: Use text overlays to maintain comprehension.
trends.source: Google Ads Shorts best practices

trends.name: Under-60-second Shorts master
trends.signal: Google recommends under-60-second Shorts ads to match user behavior, while allowing longer assets in some campaign contexts.
trends.use: Keep a sub-60-second master for Shorts delivery.
trends.treatment: Build 15/20/30/45/60-second variants from the same production package.
trends.hook: End-card and CTA should remain valid after trimming.
trends.source: Google Ads Shorts asset specifications

trends.name: Creator + brand collaboration / partner content
trends.signal: Meta supports promotion of creator-owned Reels and branded/partner content.
trends.use: Add creator-rights and partner-content metadata to the delivery package.
trends.treatment: Design the asset to remain native to the creator feed while preserving brand identity.
trends.hook: Track permission/usage status separately from creative approval.
trends.source: Meta Reels advertising guidance

trends.name: AI-assisted creative optimization
trends.signal: Meta and Google increasingly automate creative adaptation, placement and optimization.
trends.use: Separate immutable brand/claim data from model-optimized creative variables.
trends.treatment: Allow controlled machine variation of aspect ratio, text placement and asset combinations.
trends.hook: Never let optimization rewrite locked claims or product facts.
trends.source: Meta Advantage+ creative; Google multi-format/creative preferences

trends.name: Mobile-safe composition as a QA gate
trends.signal: Platform guidance repeatedly emphasizes mobile rendering, safe zones and vertical presentation.
trends.use: Make mobile-safe composition a mandatory QA gate.
trends.treatment: Check product, text, face and CTA against platform safe zones.
trends.hook: Reject clipped text, hidden product details or CTA collisions.
trends.source: Meta Reels guidance; Google Shorts guidance
